name: tdd-refactor
description: Find one small refactoring or architecture improvement, cover current behavior with tests first, then perform the refactor safely with compatibility guardrails.

interface.shortDescription: Small safe refactors with tests first
interface.longDescription: Find one small architecture or code quality improvement, characterize existing behavior with public-interface tests, refactor only while green, preserve backward compatibility, and report validation plus residual risk.
defaultPrompt: Use $tdd-refactor to find a small architecture improvement, cover it with tests first, then refactor safely.
Use $tdd-refactor in this repo and preserve public API compatibility.
Find one small refactor opportunity and do it TDD style without behavior changes.
